people.name: Nain
people.line: A town in Galilee where Jesus raised a widow's son

translations.web: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
translations.bsb: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain. His disciples went with Him, accompanied by a large crowd.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people.
translations.asv: And it came to pass soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great multitude.
